name: Marion County, FL
findings: Marion County has 855 nonprofit organizations. 279 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 209 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Marion County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
37% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 4 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 33 would.

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?
